paite: Jerusalem kholakte ah vialtai unla, chiamteh un! Amual tamte zong unla, mi khat bek diktattak a hih a, thutak zong mahmah na muh theih uleh, Jerusalem ka ngaidam ding.
heading: Jerusalem Khelhna
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

paite: "TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi mah le uh, zuau in akichiam lel uh ahi.
english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, thutak na muhnop ahi kei a hia? Amau na sat a, himahleh alungkham tuan kei uh, amau na hihmang a, na thuzohna apom nuam tuan kei uh, suangpi sang a tak in atal uh ataksak ua, akilehhei nuam kei bikbek uhi.
english: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

paite: "Ke'n, hiaite miphalou, ahai lai ua, TOUPA dan, a Pathian uh thugel athei kei uhi.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.

paite: Miliante kiang ah ka hohta ding a, ka houpih ding a, amau zaw TOUPA dan leh Pathian thugelte athei uh," achi a. Himahleh hiai mite'n thukhat sat in, hakkol ahihtan ua, henna khau ahihtat uhi.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

paite: Huaiziak in gammang nuai a humpinelkai in amaute akei ding a, gamdai ngia in amaute ane bei ding a, gialbem in akhopite a tang in, huai a hong pawt peuhmah abotzan ding; atatleknate uh atam a, anungkinnate uh athupi mahmah ziak in.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

paite: "Bangchi in ka hon ngaidam thei dia? Na tate'n ahon paisan ua, Pathian hiloupite sam in akichiam ua, taitak a ka vak nung in ang a kawm ua, kizuak innte ah akivel hehu uh.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

paite: Amaute zingsang a sakol vakvah bang mai ahi ua, michih ama invengpa zi enlah in aham hi.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

paite: Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichibang nam tung ah phu ka kilaksak kei ding a hia?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Abaangte ah kaltou unla, hihsia un, himahleh hihse khin vek kei un, ahiangte lamang un, TOUPA a lah ahi ngal kei hi.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.

paite: Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n ka tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA bel zuauthei dia sep in, "Bangmah ahihthei sam kei ding, siatna i tung uah atung kei ding, kial hiam namsau hiam i thuak kei ding.
heading: TOUPA'N Israel Apampaih
english: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

paite: Zawlneite leng huihzam lel ahi ding ua, amau ah thu a-om kei a; atung uah hichibang a hih ahi ding,” achi uhi.
english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte Pathian in achi: "Huchibang thu na gen ziak un, ngai in, na kam a ka thute mei ka suaksak ding a, hiai mipi singte akang khin ding.”
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

paite: Ngai un, aw Israel inkote aw, gamlapi a kipan, nam khat na kiang ah ka hon pi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nam hattak, nidanglai a kipan a, apau uh na theih louh, athugen uh na theih louh namte.
english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.

paite: Athalbawm uh han kihong ahi a, avek un mihattak ahi khin uh.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

paite: Na buhlaksa leh na nek ding ane khin vek ding uh; na tanute na tapate nek ding mahmah; na ganhonte, na belamhonte ane ding ua, na grep guite, na theipi kungte ane ding ua, na khopi kulh nei, na muanpi pente mahmah namsau in ahihse ding uhi.
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

paite: "Himahleh huai nite ah leng ka hon hihchimit kei ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, "Bangziak a ToUPA i Pathian un hiai thil tengteng i tung ua hih ahia?" Na mite un achih hun chiang un, "N'on paisan ua, na gam ua pathian dangte nna na sep bang un, na gam lou uah, paudang mite nna na sem ding uh, akiang uah na chi ding ahi."
english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

paite: "Jakob inkote lak ah hiai genkhia unla, Judah gam ah puang un.
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Avauhilh
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

paite: Aw theihtheihna nei lou, mihaite aw, mit nei a lah mu lou, bil nei a lah zaloute aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

paite: N'on kihta kei uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ka ma ah na ling kei ding uh maw? Kei, tuipi huap chiang a dia piautak, tangtawn a aletlouhna ding a daikaihna, tuipi kihot zou mahleh alet tuan theih louh a, ging honhon mahleh akhen theih louh ding bawlpa ka hi.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

paite: Himahleh hiai mite'n genhakna leh helhat lungtang apu ua, ahel ua, ataimangta uh.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

paite: Alungtang un leng, TOUPA i Pathian, ahuntak a vuah masa leh vuah nanung zusakpa, buh leh hunbi hon sehsakpa laudan i siam ding uh, achi sam kei uh.
english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

paite: Hiai thilte na thulimlouhnate un ahihmang a, na khelhnate un thil hoih nou ahon tansak ahi.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

paite: "Ka mite lak ah migilou a-om ngal ua, vasa gemmi in atan bang in atang gige ua, thang akam ua, mite aman uh.
english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

paite: Bawm vasa a dim bang mai in, a-innte uh khemna in adim a, huaiziak in ahong lian ua, ahong hauhsak lohta uhi.
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

paite: Ahong thau ua, ahong zol ua, ahi, agitlouhna thilhihte un hun chiang anei kei, pa neiloute lamzanna ding in amau lam ah apang kei uhi.
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

paite: "Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Hichibang nam tung ah ka hinna in phu ala kei ding a hia?
english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Huai gam ah thillamdangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahong tung hi.
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

paite: Zawlneite'n zuauthu agen ua, siampute'n lah amau thuthu in vai ahawm ua, ka mite'n lah huchibang hih a-ut uhi, atawp ah bangchi in na hih ding ua le?”
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
